scoring.method: Builder's own side-by-side scores (Claude, sources worker, 11 Nov 2026), not a judge: a crop of the target next to each candidate's preview (asset thumbnail, flat colour map, r187 example screenshot) or our earlier SwiftShader render (provisional, L4). Shape, surface and light, 1-10, against the target. A preview under studio or no light scores low on light by construction. Own and r187 candidates carried over from the 11 Nov single score are split into the three axes with the same mean. A separate judge re-scores on real-GPU shots.

Builder's own provisional score from SwiftShader before/after renders; the judge re-scores on real-GPU shots. pick.why: Highest builder mean: the only candidate that combines a real wind-ripple scan (Ground097) with the scene's light (lamp pools, glints, golden hour); Ground097 alone scores 5.0 as a flat preview.

recipe.base: ambientCG Ground097 (CC0, height-field photogrammetry of wind ripples): height, OpenGL normal and colour, 1k (High) and 512 (Phone), in world space at a 2.2 m tile
tsl_layers: authored transverse dune geometry (duneHeight: asymmetric stoss/lee, rounded crests, noise-bent crest lines, 8 m, <= 15 degrees, smooth normals)
low swells round the plaza (noise gradient)
Ground097 ripple normal and height along the wind, two rotated lookups blended by a noise field against repeats, slow crest warp
Ground097 at 12.1 m for the middle distance (meso bedforms)
specular AA from the mip-averaged normal length (Toksvig), anisotropy 16
world-space parallax march on the Ground097 height (16 steps within 20 m, High)
albedo: pale warm cream, soft 3-50 m mottle, scan luminance as detail, darker troughs
wet band from shoreDist and rain patches, SSR weight
grain glints: sparse world-anchored facets (1.5 px cells, per-cell level choice) with low roughness, real specular from lamps, moon and sun; lamp-map glints on WebGL

gap: Provisional (SwiftShader only): judge on the real GPU (r4 batch). Expected remaining gaps against Journey and Sable: no volumetric in-scatter round the lamps (the haze is a height-fog colour), glints from the WebGL lamp map assume light from above, and the dune field is noise-placed, not composed per view as Journey's are.
